mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_conversation_archive ( archive_uid, conversation_uid, user_id, title, summary, message_count, archive_dir, markdown_path, json_path, metadata_path, checksum, status, error_message, archived_at, restored_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{archiveUid}, #{conversationUid}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{messageCount}, #{archiveDir}, #{markdownPath}, #{jsonPath}, #{metadataPath}, #{checksum}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{archivedAt}, #{restoredAt}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, archive_uid, conversation_uid, user_id, title, summary, message_count, archive_dir, markdown_path, json_path, metadata_path, checksum, status, error_message, archived_at, restored_at, created_at, updated_at FROM assistant_conversation_archive WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_uid = #{conversationUid} AND status = 'archived' ORDER BY archived_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE assistant_conversation_archive SET status = 'restored', restored_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'archived'
